Overachiever Shen Wei traveled through time and found herself as the lowest-ranking maid in the grand residence of the Yan Prince.
The Yan Prince held a prestigious position, but his consorts were all content to live dull lives. The noble-born princess consort was as tranquil as a chrysanthemum; the concubine sought a life of monogamy; the reincarnated woman was utterly disillusioned with the Yan Prince and had given up on striving for anything; and the other timid concubines dared not make a move…
The queen of workplace competition, Shen Wei, declared: Don’t stop me! I’m going to outwork these unambitious slackers!
…
The Yan Prince had grown accustomed to the stagnant atmosphere in his harem, until a particularly skilled courtesan appeared.
This concubine was stunningly beautiful, adept at both literature and dance, hardworking, and always brought him fresh excitement. The Prince couldn’t help but take a second, then a lifetime-long, look at her.

ashen-ascension-the-divided-flame:
In a world shattered by an ancient disaster, humans rule, and beasts are enslaved.
Humanity dominates through mana and matrices, refined into rigid systems that determine status, survival, and worth. Beasts exist beneath them, bound by collars and chains, their strength reduced to mere raw Instinct and obedience. Two races. Two paths. One order that was forcefully imposed.
Until something began to change.
A hundred years ago, a meteor tore through the sky, carrying a dragon’s roar and a destiny that did not belong to this world. What fell from the skies that day wasn’t whole, and what survived was never meant to remain divided.
A human child was born in one of the most oppressed corners of the world. But something inside him was wrong.
His instincts pushed him to act when others hesitated. Power around him faltered in unfamiliar ways. Neither the human Matrix nor the beast Instinct fully accepted him, as if something essential within him had been displaced rather than lost.
As he grew, he was drawn toward Scars, places where the world itself has been wounded, and to the echoes that feel distant, yet intimately his own.…

In the Kunlun Snow Palace, a sage once said, those who pass away wander, while the living cannot let go.
Once the soul departs, it will wither like the autumn grass.
Those who are reborn from the dead, existing apart from the mortal realm, shall be shunned by all celestial sects and smitten as undead demons.
On this day, a youth awakens from within a coffin, his blood dry and his bones chilled, to find himself a century old upon opening his eyes.
A single tear from a sage awaited, a constant companion, may unravel the dreams of the past.
Seeking not immortality but a mundane death, not to lament with the ages over lost love and resentment, but only wishing to grow old with tenderness in this lifetime, beneath the white clouds that hold no envy for the heavenly realms.

10x.
100x.
1,000x.

rich-young-mistress-young-master-xies-de:
Yun Bixue is in dire straits—
Her fiancé has abandoned her for the country’s top socialite. Worst of all, her family has been declared bankrupt, and the media has forced her into desperation. In her desolation, she seeks help from the powerful Young Master Xie, and gains strength through her marriage with him during her lowest period. From that day onwards, she eggs herself to grow stronger to become the best wife for her husband.
This novel is a sweet, sugary book. There are no heart-wrenching scenes or misunderstandings.
Sugary Scene
Yun Bixue: “Limo, aren’t you going to ask who I met today?”
Xie Limo: “It doesn’t matter who you met. What matters is that you’re here by my side now.”
Yun Bixue “Limo, let’s make a pinky promise. In the future, I will trust you, and you will trust me too. We will not allow external factors to affect our home, and we’ll be just like the saying ‘if you do not abandon me, I will always be at your side until the end of my life’.”
Xie Limo met Yun Bixue’s determined gaze and without thinking, he reached out his finger and sealed the promise before intertwining their fingers together.
rise-of-the-infinite-sovereign:
Kevin Reed gained enlightenment at the brink of death, as he sees the one he pledged allegiance to, and some long-time comrades betray him.
He closes his eyes one last time thinking, 'If only I had known'
Yet against all odds, he finds himself back in time in the body of the fourth prince of the royal family of a soon-to-fall Empire.
This is the story of a Knight who uses the machinations of an Empire to take his revenge on all those who betrayed him.
A man who uses the knowledge of the future to get the best out of every situation.
A man preparing for the coming of the Era of Prodigies and Disaster.
But he would have to challenge adversity if he is to bring his ambitions to fruition.
So come along on his journey filled with twists and turns, enemies and thorns.
As we see the knowledge of the future is used at its best.
But no one, not even Ezra, could've predicted just how much Chaos this single irregularity would cause.
So join us to witness Ezra, as he rises from humble beginnings, well... maybe not so humble, to becoming a peerless existence.
As he rises from the ashes to become a True Sovereign!
This is the rise...of the Infinite Sovereign!

“What the hell—?!”
Arahan jolted awake.
This wasn’t his room.
This wasn’t his body.
Just hours ago, he had been a 30-year-old professor—one of the youngest lecturers in a prestigious college.
And now he is here, “Wait I am forgetting something.”
“Wait, I am Arahan.”
Arahan didn't know what happened, one a moment ago, he saw a glimpse of his past lives, and next moment he forgot everything.
But unconsciously he was going to take everything, fucked everyone.…
shades-of-blue-omegaverse-bl:
Blue Kent, also known as Ice King, is a Dominant Omega who despises Alphas. But for his new book, he needs an Alpha whom he can use as a model for his main character.
Luckily for Blue, an Extremely Dominant Alpha, Winter Dumont, comes into his life and offers to be used as a model for his book character.
This offer isn’t made without personal interest. Winter is a scumbag who likes conquering Omegas with fierce personalities.
Blue just happens to be an Omega who fits perfectly into Winter’s ideal prey.
With Winter relentlessly chasing Blue, will he be able to withstand temptation due to his hatred for Alphas or will Winter’s eccentric personality change his views about Alphas?
To know, tune in to the chaotic story of this gloomy x sunshine duo.
simulating-endless-possibilities-invinci:
This is a story about the protagonist gradually uncovering the truths of various cultivation realms through a simulator, continuously improving himself in the pursuit of survival.
Jiang Yifeng transmigrates into the eldest son of the Jiang family’s trading company in the Great You Kingdom. Initially, he believes he has entered an ancient society where he can spend his life idly enjoying entertainment. However, five years after his transmigration, the simulator activates.
Each simulation allows him to randomly draw different talents.
Three-Minute Enthusiasm: Every day, you will have three minutes of extraordinary heat and hard down below.
Fitness Expert: Your physical training results are beyond the ordinary.
Eye of Insight: You can see partial information about everyone.
Extreme One-for-One: The person who kills you will die simultaneously with you.
During his first simulation, Jiang Yifeng discovers that this world is not what he thought—it has cultivators. Moreover, in just over a decade, these cultivators will come to destroy his family.…
skyrim-a-sorcerers-tale:
A bitter old man gets tossed into the world of Tamriel, as a descendant of a religious madman no less, watch as he delves into the secrets of magic and explores the wonders of this danger-filled world, and with luck and a lot of magic juice possibly even beyond.
This is my first attempt at writing a fanfic (or anything for that matter). English is not my native language but I think there shouldn't be too many mistakes. The story will focus on magic and exploration with most likely a bit of romance later on.
sorry-our-captain-is-a-true-all-rounder:
Lin Jingjing and her friends transmigrated together to the interstellar era, and she became a Grade D Spiritual Ability User.
At the very beginning, she was mocked by others and was almost beaten to death.
Lin Jingjing was furious. So what if your grade is high?
Does having a high grade mean you can do whatever you want!
Not wanting to be bullied, Lin Jingjing, who wanted to become stronger, trained hard every day.
Just so that one day, she could trample these powerful experts under her feet, one by one.
Until the day the mutant beasts attacked, Lin Jingjing was in a daze after her spiritual power suddenly materialized as she tried to save someone.
Isn't it that only S-Class experts and above can materialize their spiritual power?
How could she, a mere Grade D, do it too?
soul-of-searing-steel: Joshua woke up in the middle of a battlefield one day only to discover that he has been transmigrated into a popular MMORPG, Continental War. Discovering that he has not only been displaced in space but also in time, Joshua realizes he has knowledge of the events unfolding around the world as he had played through them as game events. Read on to discover how Joshua forges his path towards becoming a legendary warrior!
sss-rank-chef-rising-in-the-world-of-mag:
slum kitchens to royal banquets, he turns anything edible into a dish that can heal, buff, or embarrass the hell out of arrogant nobles.
Armed with knives sharper than a knight's sword and recipes more dangerous than a mage's spell, he leaves a trail of awestruck patrons, jealous chefs, and confused warriors in his wake. Husbands flock to him, leaving their wives wondering if they have a secret family. Monsters tremble at the thought of landing on his hot grill, while mages fume over the man who drank a lemonade and shot out a fireball the size of a meteor.
His dishes are more potent than a god's blessing… because in this world, the right meal can change everything.
00000
Basic Info: Lukas gains a SSS rank talent named Divine Chef. It enables him to give magical effects to every single thing he cooks. It could be stat increases, skills and more. Along with this, he also receives a skill that allows him to cultivate crops. Using a regular potato, he can grow magical ones infused with mana, which with further enhance the dishes he makes.
strongest-conqueror-of-the-beast-domain:
Being a nobody from a poor district of the Federation, Nick is a sixteen year old boy just trying to find his place in the world. When he finally gets his shot to enter the Beast Domain upon turning sixteen, he jumps at the opportunity to finally make something of himself — to carve out his own future.
His goal? Survive. Hunt. Earn enough money to finally support his little sister back home and bring them out of poverty.
But to a naïve young boy like Nick, the world is far more sinister than it seems — leaving him no choice but to adapt or die.
To a poor young man like Nick, though, there was only one choice he could make.
Follow Nick as he navigates these obstacles and carves out a future for himself and his sister, all while uncovering the various mysteries that shroud his worldview in darkness.
surviving-the-assassin-academy-as-a-geni:
I became a professor in a game by accident.
To make matters worse, I even messed up the difficulty settings.
Now, I’m stuck playing on Hell Mode.
A world on the brink of war with the Demon King.
An Assassin Department where mu*der is legal… as long as you aren’t caught.
I thought I’d have to claw my way through just to survive in this wretched place, and that was the case at first.
But nowadays…
“No matter how hard I try, I can’t be like you, Professor… How do you do it?”
“Please… become our god.”
“What do you know? What is it you know? Why do you make me want to live…?”
One by one, everyone at the academy began to obsess over me.
that-time-an-american-was-reincarnated-i:
It’s not always the Asians who get isekaied. Very rarely does an American get chosen, though the lords of isekai have reasons for that.
It’s time for John to remind them of those reasons.
This story started as a gag. It is no longer a gag.
the-best-director:
Wang Yang never stopped pursuing his dream of becoming a director and making movies that could amaze the world. However, the fate seemed to play a malicious joke on him. He got wrongly accused and expelled from USC. Fortunately, when God closed a door to Wang Yang, he opened a window for him. After a baby stroller hit him on the street, he began to be able to watch the movies from the future in his head!
Since then, the year of 1988 was destined to be an extraordinary year. Besides the miracle written by “Titanic”, one of the most legendary directors in the 21st century was rising quietly…
the-cursed-extra:
After mocking a webnovel's most pathetic villain, Alex never expected to wake up in his body.
Now he is Kaelen Leone, the laughingstock of the Royal Academy, a walking punchline with a pre-scripted fate: to be publicly crippled by the story’s golden-boy protagonist. Transported into a world governed by a System and a merciless plot, he finds himself in a deadly game of survival not against monsters, but against the narrative itself.
What's worse, the unique power he awakens comes with a small, but potentially fatal condition…
the-devil-doctors-spicy-love:
Rumors say that if you ever come across an extremely handsome man in a doctor's coat twirling a shiny scalpel between his fingers with an alluring smile on his lips that takes your breath away…
Run.
For he is the devil.
***
Yang Mingshen’s existence screams of six adjectives - Handsome, wealthy, talented, narcissist, arrogant and evil.
He is an unrivaled doctor from one of the most affluent and prestigious Underworld families, who sees only medicine and his own interests. Until a desire consumes him - to have a woman’s heart.
That woman, Song Jia, continues to put all the wrongs to right as a capable police officer. She, whose life was once saved by the devil doctor, refuses to bend to his tempting seduction.
“I will just take your heart and put it in somebody else's chest. It won't hurt at all, I promise~”
“Yes because I will be dead to feel anything.”
But the bad news comes knocking when Yang Mingshen becomes the lead forensic investigator to assist in her cases. With a devil now clinging to her, she comes across a deep, dark and cruel web of conspiracies stained with blood, love, hatred, revenge, politics and much more.…
the-first-dragon-god:
[The citizens of planet #674589 has been given the opportunity to awaken.]
With this abrupt message that appeared out of nowhere, the world as everyone knew it had ended.
A series of apocalyptic level of natural disaster washed over the Earth, claiming numerous lives in the process.
Every lifeform on earth that managed to survive the apocalyptic natural disaster was given immense power.
Animals metamorphosed into terrifying beasts and various plants gained self-awareness, while the surviving humans gained powerful supernatural abilities.
Leo, a young man finally left the orphanage, a place he'd called home for his entire 16 years of life. With his dreams of finally breaking free and experiencing adult life outside of the orphanage finally coming true, his world was turned upside down after receiving the message with the rest of the world.
Freedom was no longer something given, it now had to be earned. This apocalyptic and ruined world was something that could take kill him in an instant.
[Requirements met. First Seal Broken.]
[Innate skill awakened: Regeneration.]
the-force-of-the-north: After a vending machine accident, an otaku meets a deity resembling Morgan Freeman and is reincarnated as Eddard “Ned” Stark to save the Game of Thrones universe. To survive, he secures three wishes: usage of The Force (adapted to the Old Gods and Direwolves), intuitive civilization-building knowledge, and a 10x growth multiplier for training.
the-girls-are-all-coveting-me:
“I have repeatedly emphasized that the Desire Mother Tree is inherently an Evil God, so how could it possibly have descended to the human world because of my pure friendship with them.”
In the Star Calendar year 1999, when the Morning Star Pope Chloe faced an interview with reporters, he was asked about his romantic past with the yandere senior, the noble lady, the Blindfolded Saintess, the fairy mentor, and others, as well as the incident of the Evil God's descent. He denied these.
“But the Chosen Sword of the hero Rephya identifies you as the Demon King!”
“I have dedicated my limited life to the infinite cause of fighting against the Evil God. I am very certain I am not the Demon King.”
……
In the Star Calendar year 2000, the hero Rephya failed to vanquish the Demon King because she had his child.
the-strongest-legend-of-dragon-ball: Xiaya reincarnated in the Dragon Ball Universe as a Saiyan 12 years before the destruction of Planet Vegeta. Watch him as he creates the strongest legend of Dragon Ball World from the beginning.
the-ultimate-evolution:
I traverse along the pathway of darkness and imagination...
Entering the realm born by human imaginations...
Challenging Harry Potter’s magic, commanding the great Pirates of the Caribbean.
Terminating the Terminator’s strength, tearing apart the Matrix’s Hallucination.
Virus is my slave.
Endurance my inheritance.
Growing and hunting in the boundless universe.
Breaking through boundaries in a mysterious space.
Desiring evil, conspiracy and betrayer. Who can redeem what was already lost?
In a battle of demons, who can leave an immortal legacy?
A declining Trump card, Final evolution!
I’m... on a journey!
We are one!
the-wife-of-the-wealthy-family-is-fierce:
A woman from ancient times falls in love with her soulmate.
Chu Luo is the most powerful High Priestess. She is like a celestial being, able to peer into the secrets of heaven and sever life and death. Her skills in medicine and poison are the best in the world.
One day sudden death greets her and she is reborn in the body of a problematic girl who was about to graduate from high school and had planned to commit suicide by jumping off a building because of a failed confession.
Her parents did not love her; her biological sister bullied her, and her classmates were violent…
The corners of Chu Luo’s lips curls up into a cold arc. ‘Very good, anyone who dares to bully me will be killed without mercy!’
…
Later…
The priest is only passionate about three things:
1. Being first place wins all kinds of certificate awards.
2. Specialize in all kinds of things and never admit defeat.
3. Act cute to Li Yan.
…
Li Yan is the king of the business empire. He is cold-blooded, heartless, and has a violent temperament. He disregards his family and is called the Devil in private.
Legend has it that a few years ago, he burned away half of his family with a fire.…
tragic-life-of-the-prince:
Ralf, a transmigrator from Earth, finds himself amid a power struggle for the throne of the Kingdom of Marer when the King falls ill.
His brothers are all vying for the position of the next king, with only the victor surviving while the rest are killed.
As the competition heats up, the princes become increasingly ruthless, willing to sacrifice anything to gain the upper hand, even their women.
But with so much at stake, can he trust anyone, even those closest to him?
As the battle for the throne intensifies, Ralf must grapple with his moral compass and decide what kind of ruler he wants to be.
Will he follow in the footsteps of his brothers and sacrifice everything for power, or will he forge his path and create a better future for the Kingdom of Marer?
I know many of you would run away by seeing the NTR tag but even if you don't like NTR, I still urge you to read it as this story is different, you will understand once you check it out.
Just remember, There is no Mc in this story, it's a bunch of characters who are fighting for the throne and are ready to sacrifice anything for it.
undressed-by-his-arrogance:
Have you ever had the worst first day at work?
Ivy Morales has.
Nothing compares to the sheer humiliation of being caught 'tits out' by the sinfully gorgeous Winn Kane, her new boss.
Ivy’s got problems. Money problems, boyfriend problems and a desperate need to prove herself. But the more she pushes to show she’s more than just a girl with killer curves, incredible tits and a smart mouth, the deeper she gets tangled in his dangerous orbit.
Winn Kane should have fired her. Instead, he keeps testing her, pushing her, wanting her.
She found a job. He found an obsession.
This is a scorching office romance and temptation is the job description.
woke-up-at-my-own-wedding-my-wifes-recov:
Lucius went to sleep on Earth.
He woke up at his own wedding.
Transported to another world on the brink of collapse, Luke suddenly finds himself married to Lady Valeria Chamberlin—the youngest SSS-Rank Mage in history and one of humanity's greatest heroes.
At least, she used to be.
After a mysterious Rift accident stole her hearing, her magic, and her future, Valeria was discarded by the noble family she devoted her life to protecting.
Now she spends her days as a forgotten academy professor while the world slowly moves on without her.
When a mysterious system awakens after their marriage, Luke discovers that every step Valeria takes toward recovery grants him power in return.
As they face dangerous Rifts, academy politics, and the truth behind the accident that ruined her life, Luke finds himself determined to accomplish the impossible:
Restore the fallen legend.
And maybe, along the way, win her heart.
young-master-feng-your-lady-has-stunned-:
Twenty years ago, the Gu family’s eldest daughter, Gu Wan, went missing without any news on her whereabouts.
The Gu family was left with only the youngest daughter, Gu Chu, so they doted on her.
Twenty years later, Gu Wan returned. Gu Chu was thrilled and she showed her sister around the city, even giving her everything she treasured.
However, Gu Chu gradually realized that Gu Wan was here to take everything away from her, including her fiance! Their mother said, “We owe Gu Wan all of this. We all do, especially you! Gu Wan only went missing back then because you insisted on having a candy.
That’s why Gu Wan went out and ended up going missing!
She had suffered for twenty years out there! You will never be able to fully repay Gu Wan what you owed her!
Hence, the engagement with the Feng family should be given to Gu Wan!”
Their mother even said, “When we arranged this marriage with the Feng family, although we didn’t specify if it was for Gu Wan or Gu Chu, the elder child should take precedence.
Gu Wan should’ve been the first choice. And now that she’s back, she should take what was rightfully hers. What’s wrong with that?” Gu Chu wanted to defend herself.…
zatarias-last-light:
Two Zatarian youths embark on a cross-dimensional journey to uncover their true identities, encountering both allies and formidable adversaries along the way.
They must collaborate to decipher the significance of the symbol imprinted on them, but a faction known as the Nitharians seeks to eliminate them before they can uncover the truth. Naburo, the leader of the Nitharians, has dispatched his most trusted son and his team to guarantee the success of this mission.
Will Naburo's son and his team prevail before the Zatarians discover their true selves?
